title: fix(ui): check-skill-eval-tokens reads must_contain_any — shape, every member taught, tally
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLCo5F2y7fgbM8tstGoyyUn)_

Fixes #37978 — under the maintainer's ruling **A** on the card (7222376446, 「A 按现状收 PR,改正卡片」), the acceptance is the gate reading `must_contain_any` for its own population (`skills/objectui`): shape refusals, every group member scored as taught, groups-only cases out of the EMPTY tally, no `must_contain` verdict moved. This PR is that change.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；技能评测的「必含词必须是文档教过的词」这道内部检查，现在也会检查「几种写法任一即算对」的新写法，检查格式，也检查每个候选词文档里有没有。
- 为什么做：属于技能评测质量这条线，为以后改用新写法的评测题把关，免得题目要求一个文档从没教过的词。
- 出错会怎样：只影响这道检查自己，最坏是某题被误判，改回即可撤回，不碰任何产品功能。
- 要你做的：无。另有一件事交给席位：这道检查今天只看界面技能包，第 6 题所在的平台技能包它根本不读，要不要扩大检查范围需要定夺。

## What changes

`ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` now reads `assertions.must_contain_any`, the any-of form the skill-evals runner grades since #37969 (`anyOfProblem` in `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cases.ts`):

1. **Shape.** New `anyOfShape()` makes the runner's four refusals, one finding each: the value is not a list (`not-an-array`), a group is not a list of strings (`bad-group`), a group is empty (`empty-group`), a group holds an empty token (`bad-token`). A malformed group is not scored, the same way a malformed `must_contain` entry is not.
2. **Taught: every member, not at least one.** Each member of each well-formed group becomes a row, scored by the same bundle-wide oracle and whole-token rule as a `must_contain` token, and also under the rejected per-guide oracle that `--measure` prints. **Why every member:** any one member passes an answer. So a member the bundle never says is a word the case accepts as correct without the skill ever teaching it. That is the same untaught-token defect, reached through a group. "At least one" would let that member through.
   A member's row key carries its group: `... eval ID must_contain_any[G] TOKEN`. A baseline row therefore names exactly one member of one group. `rowKey()` output for a `must_contain` token is byte-identical to before.
3. **Tally.** A case whose only positive assertion is groups is no longer counted in the "must_contain is EMPTY" tally. Its members also count toward the population, so a bundle made only of such cases is not refused as `empty-population`.
4. **Self-test.** There are 13 new `--self-test` rows (31 to 44), covering each axis in both directions. There are 4 new vitest pins in `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-skill-eval-tokens.test.ts`: the four shape reasons plus the well-formed pass, every-member scoring with the one untaught member red and keyed by its group, the key shape, and the tally and population direction.

The header documents the form. The summary lines now also count `must_contain_any` members and groups. Baselines: `KNOWN_UNTAUGHT_EVAL_TOKENS` stays empty, and no row is needed.

No changeset, labelled `skip-changeset`: `ui/` is the private `object-ui-monorepo` root package, and `ui/scripts/**` ships in no published package's `files[]`.

## Tests

<details><summary>Self-test and vitest, on head 8ac75d787f</summary>

- `node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs --self-test` printed `OK check-skill-eval-tokens self-test: 44 cases pass (...)` with exit 0. It was 31 cases before.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-skill-eval-tokens.test.ts` under the lock gave `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 34 passed (34)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` exited 0: `128 must_contain token(s) and 0 must_contain_any member(s) in 0 group(s)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: each new branch broken once, then restored by blob hash</summary>

Each run used `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs ... -- node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs --self-test`. Each restore was proven as blob == HEAD (`f61ab5068e2b`) with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- Shape (`anyOf.problems` replaced by an empty list): exit 1, 4 of 44 failed, all four shape rows.
- Taught (only the first member of each group scored): exit 1, 2 of 44 failed: "every member of a taught group passes, and is scored" and "ONE untaught member reds its group".
- Tally (the groups condition dropped): exit 1, 1 of 44 failed: "a case whose only positive assertion is groups is NOT in the EMPTY tally". The first attempt was refused by the tool before running, because its replacement text already occurred in the file. The re-run used a distinct replacement.

</details>

<details><summary>No verdict moves: --list and --measure before and after</summary>

Both outputs were captured on `dc45b1e65c` and on this head, then diffed. All 128 row lines of `--list`, and every row of both red lists in `--measure`, are identical. The only changed lines are the four summary lines: the scan count, the oracle sentence, the EMPTY tally label and the success line. Exit 0 both times. The per-guide red count is 18 both times.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The premise half that does not hold: this gate never reads case 6.** `skillsWalk()` in `ui/scripts/skill-bundle-root.mjs` narrows the walk to `skills/objectui` in the monorepo. The vitest pin "the real corpus" asserts the bundle list equals `['skills/objectui']`, and Lint UI's path filter in `ci.yml` names `skills/objectui/**`. So `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json` case 6 is outside the population on `main` and on this branch alike.
- I measured with `analyze({ root: REPO_ROOT })`, which walks the whole catalog, on this head. All four case-6 members are taught in `skills/objectstack-ai`: `ai:approve` 1, `signed-in session` 1, `refused` 17, `never decides` 1, whole-token counts. Widening the gate to all 14 bundles would also red **131** existing `must_contain` rows across 11 of the 13 other bundles, including case 12's `context:` and `policy_document`, plus 4 `forbids-own-answer` findings. The EMPTY tally there goes 71 to 70 with this change, because case 6 leaves it. So the population question was a scope decision, not a mechanical edit. **Ruled A (7222376446):** the acceptance is narrowed to this gate's own population; widening to the `objectstack-*` bundles (options B, C, D), any `ci.yml` edit and the one-off audit are not ruled and not in scope. Case 6's four tokens were checked by hand.
- Head `603494f7` adds only a JSDoc type on `rowKey` to `8ac75d78` (the head the Tests section cites), fixing Type Check UI's TS2345; the gate, `--self-test`, the vitest file and `type-check:scripts` were re-run green on it. L1 ACCEPT 7222137031 at `603494f7`.
- `--self-test` here has no battery floor or handshake, which is the shape AGENTS.md now asks of self-tests. This is pre-existing. Noted only.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `anyOfShape()` and the scoring loop in `analyze()`. The risk is the `must_contain` row order or key changing. The before and after `--list` diff above shows it did not.
2. The new `must_contain_any` self-test block.

Two-minute check: `node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs --self-test` prints `44 cases pass` and exits 0.
